decisions.reason: Product C is close to the established offer, has held its own webpage for two years, and with industry growth and slack the results likely meet aspirations, so the firm has little reason to search for alternatives.
Product D is distant from the established offer and still uncertain after one year, but the firm's expansion and R&D suggest enough slack to carry it while it is evaluated.
Product E is close to the established offer but only mentioned on the website, indicating early or uncertain results, yet available slack supports keeping it for now.
